S24.04.needs: a signed-in account, and a chat that has produced at least one artifact; live-web (the preview needs the artifact sandbox origin)
S24.04.note: The list shows only the outputs of the current chat (conversationOutputs in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/artifactPanel.ts), not every artifact the user has across all chats; no all-chats artifact list was found in apps/extension after one search for artifact. The plan's Code line was unverified and the plan's Where line was empty, so this location comes from the code search.
steps: Sign in, open the side panel, and open a chat that has produced an artifact (the Outputs button is hidden when a chat has no outputs).
Look at the header: the Outputs button shows a count. Click it.
In the Outputs list, check that each artifact appears as a row with its title and a short meta line.
Click Open on an artifact row. The Artifact panel opens for that artifact, showing its title.
Click Open on another row and check that the panel switches to that artifact. Compare with Expected: a view lists the artifacts and opens each one.
S24.04.where: Side panel header > Outputs button (shows a count) > Open on a row
